t: Lore:Valenwood - UESP Wiki - The Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages
s: At some point after finding the Flask of Lillandril in 1E 470, the Altmer used the flask to perform favors for the barons of Summerset Isle by keeping in check the magical power of the Bosmer in Valenwood.[27] One legend says that a stable boy defeated the High Wizard of Valenwood using only the flask.[28] After some time, the elves who discovered the flask feared that Bosmer assassins would kill them, so they fled hoping to buy safety from the Direnni, but perished in a shipwreck and the Flask of Lillandril was lost.[27][29][30]
